structure ByteArray where
  data : List UInt8
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Hashable

def ByteArray.length (b : ByteArray) : Nat := b.data.length

def ByteArray.eq (a b : ByteArray) : Bool := a.data == b.data

instance : BEq ByteArray where
  beq := fun a b => a.data == b.data

instance : Inhabited ByteArray where
  default := ⟨[]⟩

inductive EdgeQuality : Type where
  | superposition : EdgeQuality
  | entangled : EdgeQuality
  | coherent : EdgeQuality
  | collapsed : EdgeQuality
  | fractal : EdgeQuality
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Hashable, Inhabited

def EdgeQuality.toNat : EdgeQuality → Nat
  | .superposition => 0
  | .entangled => 1
  | .coherent => 2
  | .collapsed => 3
  | .fractal => 4

def EdgeQuality.toString : EdgeQuality → String
  | .superposition => "superposition"
  | .entangled => "entangled"
  | .coherent => "coherent"
  | .collapsed => "collapsed"
  | .fractal => "fractal"

def EdgeQuality.fromString (s : String) : Option EdgeQuality :=
  if s == "superposition" then some .superposition
  else if s == "entangled" then some .entangled
  else if s == "coherent" then some .coherent
  else if s == "collapsed" then some .collapsed
  else if s == "fractal" then some .fractal
  else none

theorem EdgeQuality.toString_injective : Function.Injective EdgeQuality.toString := by
  intro a b h
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [EdgeQuality.toString] at h

theorem EdgeQuality.fromString_toString (e : EdgeQuality) : EdgeQuality.fromString (EdgeQuality.toString e) = some e := by
  cases e <;> rfl

theorem EdgeQuality.toString_fromString (s : String) (e : EdgeQuality) : EdgeQuality.fromString s = some e → EdgeQuality.toString e = s := by
  intro h
  cases e <;> simp [EdgeQuality.fromString, EdgeQuality.toString] at h ⊢ <;> split at h <;> try contradiction <;> assumption

structure Qubit where
  a : Complex
  b : Complex
  normalized : a.normSq + b.normSq = 1 ∨ (a = 0 ∧ b = 0)
  deriving Inhabited

def Complex.ofReal (r : Float) : Complex := ⟨r.toReal, 0⟩

def Complex.magnitudeSquared (c : Complex) : Real := c.normSq

def Qubit.normSquared (q : Qubit) : Real := q.a.normSq + q.b.normSq

theorem Qubit.normSquared_nonneg (q : Qubit) : 0 ≤ q.normSquared := by
  unfold normSquared
  apply add_nonneg <;> apply Complex.normSq_nonneg

def Qubit.init (a b : Complex) : Qubit :=
  let ns := a.normSq + b.normSq
  if h : ns > 0 ∧ ¬ns.isNaN ∧ ¬ns.isInf then
    let inv := 1 / Real.sqrt ns
    let a' := ⟨a.re * inv, a.im * inv⟩
    let b' := ⟨b.re * inv, b.im * inv⟩
    ⟨a', b', by left; ring_nf; sorry⟩
  else
    ⟨⟨1, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0⟩, by left; simp [Complex.normSq]; norm_num⟩

def Qubit.initBasis0 : Qubit := ⟨⟨1, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0⟩, by left; simp [Complex.normSq]; norm_num⟩

def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit := ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, ⟨1, 0⟩, by left; simp [Complex.normSq]; norm_num⟩

theorem Qubit.initBasis0_normalized : (Qubit.initBasis0.a.normSq + Qubit.initBasis0.b.normSq) = 1 := by
  simp [initBasis0, Complex.normSq]
  norm_num

theorem Qubit.initBasis1_normalized : (Qubit.initBasis1.a.normSq + Qubit.initBasis1.b.normSq) = 1 := by
  simp [initBasis1, Complex.normSq]
  norm_num

def Qubit.prob0 (q : Qubit) : Real := min (max q.a.normSq 0) 1

def Qubit.prob1 (q : Qubit) : Real := min (max q.b.normSq 0) 1

theorem Qubit.prob0_bounds (q : Qubit) : 0 ≤ q.prob0 ∧ q.prob0 ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · unfold prob0; apply le_min; norm_num; apply le_max_left
  · unfold prob0; apply min_le_left

theorem Qubit.prob1_bounds (q : Qubit) : 0 ≤ q.prob1 ∧ q.prob1 ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · unfold prob1; apply le_min; norm_num; apply le_max_left
  · unfold prob1; apply min_le_left

  let inv_sqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  let amp := Complex.ofReal inv_sqrt2
  ⟨fun i => match i with
    | ⟨0, _⟩ => amp
    | ⟨1, _⟩ => 0
    | ⟨2, _⟩ => 0
    | ⟨3, _⟩ => amp,

theorem TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus_entangled : ∃ (i j : Fin 4), i ≠ j ∧ TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus.amps i ≠ 0 ∧ TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus.amps j ≠ 0 := by

  let b' := ⟨(q.a.re - q.b.re) * inv_sqrt2, (q.a.im - q.b.im) * inv_sqrt2⟩
  Qubit.init a' b'

  let b' := ⟨q.b.re * factor.re - q.b.im * factor.im, q.b.re * factor.im + q.b.im * factor.re⟩

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.entangleNodes (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a_id b_id : ByteArray) : Option SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.canonicalId a_id, g.canonicalId b_id with
  | some a, some b =>
    let pk := g.makePairKey a b
    let g' := { g with entanglements := g.entanglements.insert pk TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus }
    let edge_ab := Edge.init a b EdgeQuality.entangled 1.0 ⟨1, 0⟩ 0.0
    let edge_ba := Edge.init b a EdgeQuality.entangled 1.0 ⟨1, 0⟩ 0.0
    match g'.addEdge a b edge_ab with
    | some g'' => g''.addEdge b a edge_ba
    | none => none
  | _, _ => none

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.measure (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : ByteArray) (randomFloat : Float) : Option (Bool × SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :=
  match g.canonicalId id with
  | none => none
  | some cid =>
    let entangled_pair := g.entanglements.toList.find? fun (pk, _) => 
      ByteArray.eq pk.a cid = true || ByteArray.eq pk.b cid = true
    match entangled_pair with
    | some (pk, state) =>
      let amp0 := state.amps ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
      let amp1 := state.amps ⟨1, by norm_num⟩
      let amp2 := state.amps ⟨2, by norm_num⟩
      let p0 := amp0.re * amp0.re + amp0.im * amp0.im
      let p1 := amp1.re * amp1.re + amp1.im * amp1.im
      let p2 := amp2.re * amp2.re + amp2.im * amp2.im
      let r := randomFloat.toReal
      let outcome := 
        if r ≤ p0 then 0
        else if r ≤ p0 + p1 then 1
        else if r ≤ p0 + p1 + p2 then 2
        else 3
      let (qa, qb) := match outcome with
        | 0 => (Qubit.initBasis0, Qubit.initBasis0)
        | 1 => (Qubit.initBasis0, Qubit.initBasis1)
        | 2 => (Qubit.initBasis1, Qubit.initBasis0)
        | _ => (Qubit.initBasis1, Qubit.initBasis1)
      let g' := g.setQuantumState pk.a qa
      let g'' := match g' with
        | some gx => gx.setQuantumState pk.b qb
        | none => none
      match g'' with
      | some g''' =>
        let g_final := { g''' with entanglements := g'''.entanglements.erase pk }
        let bit := if ByteArray.eq cid pk.a = true then outcome / 2 == 1 else outcome % 2 == 1
        some (bit, g_final)
      | none => none
    | none =>
      match g.nodes.find? (byteArrayToString cid) with
      | some n =>
        let p0 := n.qubit.prob0
        let bit := randomFloat.toReal > p0
        let q' := if bit then Qubit.initBasis1 else Qubit.initBasis0
        match g.setQuantumState cid q' with
        | some g' => some (bit, g')
        | none => none
      | none => none

def computeHash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray := 
  let h := hash data.data
  ⟨[UInt8.ofNat (h.toNat % 256)]⟩

theorem computeHash_deterministic (data : ByteArray) : computeHash data = computeHash data := rfl

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.updateTopologyHash (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let nodeData := g.nodes.toList.foldl (fun acc (_, n) => 
    acc ++ n.id.data ++ n.data.data) []
  let edgeData := g.edges.toList.foldl (fun acc (k, v) => 
    acc ++ k.source.data ++ k.target.data ++ v.edges.foldl (fun a e => a ++ [UInt8.ofNat e.quality.toNat]) []) []
  let hash := computeHash ⟨nodeData ++ edgeData⟩
  { g with topology_hash := hash }

theorem SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.updateTopologyHash_deterministic (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : (g.updateTopologyHash).updateTopologyHash = g.updateTopologyHash := by
  unfold updateTopologyHash
  simp
  have : computeHash _ = computeHash _ := computeHash_deterministic _
  rw [this]

structure GraphInvariant (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Prop where
  all_nodes_have_qubits : ∀ id n, g.getNode id = some n → ∃ q, g.getQuantumState id = some q
  edges_reference_existing_nodes : ∀ s t, (g.getEdges s t).length > 0 → g.nodes.contains (byteArrayToString s) = true ∨ g.nodes.contains (byteArrayToString t) = true
  node_count_is_size : g.nodeCount = g.nodes.size

theorem GraphInvariant.empty_satisfies (seed : Nat) : GraphInvariant (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.empty seed) := by
  constructor
  · intro id n h
    unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getNode SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.empty at h
    simp [StringHashMap.empty, StringHashMap.find?] at h
  · intro s t h
    unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getEdges SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.empty at h
    simp [Std.HashMap.findD, EdgeMapValue.empty] at h
  · rfl

theorem GraphInvariant.addNode_preserves (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (n : Node) : GraphInvariant g → GraphInvariant (g.addNode n) := by
  intro h
  constructor
  · intro id node h_node
    by_cases heq : id = n.id
    · rw [heq]
      use n.qubit
      unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addNode SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getQuantumState
      simp [StringHashMap.insert, StringHashMap.find?]
      apply Std.HashMap.find?_insert
    · have : (g.addNode n).getNode id = g.getNode id := SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getNode_addNode_different g n id heq
      rw [this] at h_node
      have ⟨q, hq⟩ := h.all_nodes_have_qubits id node h_node
      use q
      unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addNode SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getQuantumState at *
      simp [StringHashMap.insert, StringHashMap.find?] at *
      by_cases heq2 : byteArrayToString id = byteArrayToString n.id
      · have : id = n.id := byteArrayToString_injective id n.id heq2
        contradiction
      · apply Std.HashMap.find?_insert_ne
        exact heq2
        exact hq
  · intro s t h_edges
    left
    apply SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addNode_contains
  · rfl

theorem GraphInvariant.addEdge_preserves (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (s t : ByteArray) (e : Edge) (g' : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : GraphInvariant g → g.addEdge s t e = some g' → GraphInvariant g' := by
  intro h_inv h_add
  constructor
  · intro id n h_node
    have h_nodes_eq : g'.nodes = g.nodes := by
      unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge at h_add
      split at h_add
      · split at h_add
        · injection h_add with h_add
          rw [h_add]
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
    rw [h_nodes_eq] at h_node
    have ⟨q, hq⟩ := h_inv.all_nodes_have_qubits id n h_node
    use q
    have h_qr_eq : g'.quantum_register = g.quantum_register := by
      unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge at h_add
      split at h_add
      · split at h_add
        · injection h_add with h_add
          rw [h_add]
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
    unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getQuantumState at *
    rw [h_qr_eq]
    exact hq
  · intro s2 t2 h_edges
    left
    have h_nodes_eq : g'.nodes = g.nodes := by
      unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge at h_add
      split at h_add
      · split at h_add
        · injection h_add with h_add
          rw [h_add]
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
    rw [h_nodes_eq]
    by_cases h_new : s2 = s ∧ t2 = t
    · have ⟨hs, ht⟩ := h_new
      unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge at h_add
      split at h_add
      · rename_i cs ct
        split at h_add
        · rename_i hs_some ht_some
          have : cs = some s := hs_some
          have : ct = some t := ht_some
          injection h_add with h_add
          rw [hs, ht]
          simp at this
          have h_s_contains : g.nodes.contains (byteArrayToString s) = true := by
            unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.canonicalId at hs_some
            split at hs_some
            · rename_i n hn
              have : StringHashMap.find? g.nodes (byteArrayToString s) = some n := hn
              have : StringHashMap.contains g.nodes (byteArrayToString s) = true := by
                unfold StringHashMap.contains
                apply Std.HashMap.contains_of_find?
                exact this
              exact this
            · contradiction
          exact h_s_contains
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
    · have : (g.getEdges s2 t2).length > 0 := by
        have h_edges_subset : ∀ s t, (g.getEdges s t).length ≤ (g'.getEdges s t).length := by
          intro sx tx
          unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getEdges
          unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge at h_add
          split at h_add
          · split at h_add
            · injection h_add with h_add
              rw [h_add]
              simp [Std.HashMap.findD]
              by_cases heq : EdgeKey.mk sx tx = EdgeKey.mk s t
              · apply Nat.le_of_lt
                have : (Std.HashMap.findD g.edges (EdgeKey.mk sx tx) EdgeMapValue.empty).edges.length < ((Std.HashMap.findD g.edges (EdgeKey.mk sx tx) EdgeMapValue.empty).append e).edges.length := by
                  have : ((Std.HashMap.findD g.edges (EdgeKey.mk sx tx) EdgeMapValue.empty).append e).edges.length = (Std.HashMap.findD g.edges (EdgeKey.mk sx tx) EdgeMapValue.empty).edges.length + 1 := EdgeMapValue.append_increases_length _ _
                  rw [this]
                  omega
                simp [Std.HashMap.findD] at this
                sorry
              · sorry
            · contradiction
          · contradiction
        have : (g'.getEdges s2 t2).length > 0 := h_edges
        have := h_edges_subset s2 t2
        sorry
      have := h_inv.edges_reference_existing_nodes s2 t2 this
      exact this
  · unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.nodeCount
    have : g'.nodes.size = g.nodes.size := by
      unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge at h_add
      split at h_add
      · split at h_add
        · injection h_add with h_add
          rw [h_add]
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
    rw [this]
    exact h_inv.node_count_is_size

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.hasPath (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (start finish : ByteArray) (maxDepth : Nat) : Bool :=
  let rec dfs (visited : List ByteArray) (current : ByteArray) (depth : Nat) : Bool :=
    if depth = 0 then false
    else if ByteArray.eq current finish then true
    else if visited.any (fun v => ByteArray.eq v current) then false
    else
      let neighbors := g.edges.toList.filterMap fun (k, v) =>
        if ByteArray.eq k.source current then some k.target else none
      neighbors.any (fun n => dfs (current :: visited) n (depth - 1))
  dfs [] start maxDepth
